reasons: to renew the tea utensils that time has worn
to acquire seasonal flowers that are not available here
to maintain the space where we practice the art of presence
to repair the shamisen that accompanies long evenings
to buy quality paper that deserves the proper ink
to prepare a ceremony that honors those who sustain this community
to restore the necessary silence between notes and words
to bring spring water that true tea requires

new_moon: The primordial darkness awaits your intention. Seeds planted in silence will bloom in their season.
waxing_crescent: Light grows gently like cherry blossoms. Time to plant intentions with grace.
first_quarter: Action becomes necessary. Face obstacles with the elegance of a tea ceremony.
waxing_gibbous: Energy accumulates like incense smoke. Refine your plans like arranging ikebana.
full_moon: Maximum power manifests. The moon shines like a mirror, revealing truth and beauty.
waning_gibbous: The harvest is gathered. Express gratitude like after a formal tea ceremony.
last_quarter: Time for reflection. Release what no longer serves, like autumn leaves falling.
waning_crescent: Sacred rest. Meditate in silence, like a moonlit garden at night.
